candidate_order: alpha outer, beta inner; ascending listed order
tie_break: first candidate with the minimum unrounded objective
objective: mean across regimes and channels of pooled training MAE / frozen training std_sample
gain_scope: one scalar alpha/beta pair shared by all channels and regimes
slope_caps: reuse frozen linear_extrapolation_v1 q99 caps without refitting
randomness: none; existing frozen training masks only
